issues.detail: The manifest probe binding includes evidence_id:null. The new verifier initially compared this object literally to path/SHA binding. It now checks path/SHA exactly and removes only the informational null evidence ID for the unchanged prior provenance validator.
Original-only audit rejects v1 for 71 probe errors before any custom behavior validation. Positive-row 4199a0 return frames are absent. No compatibility PASS report generated.

First v2 semantic pass reached a typed DYNARY row, then lookup-store comparison used the overwritten row endpoint variable. A dedicated lookup_store local fixed this KeyError; no native behavior expectation changed.
Default run record now selects successful v2c PID4084. Earlier v2 gate_timeout and v2b process_error are preserved and fail provenance.
